\begin{circuitikz}[american]
  \draw (0,0)
    to[R=2<\ohm>, i=?, v=84<\volt>] (3,0)
    -- (3,2)
    to[C=$C_1$] (1.5,2)
    to[V<=$\SI{5}{\volt}$] (0,2)
    -- (0,0);
